transposeRanges.basis: Source P10–P13 old horn bass clef at XML128; International Horn Society historical convention, independently reviewed by VerS.

bars.description: Encoded bars 1–311 once; source-defined staves grouped only by orchestral section. No synthetic instrumental parts are added.

endpoints.basis: Score-pitch energy-rise search windows; provisional automatic alignment, not listening annotations.

provenance: Original CC0 orchestral MusicXML retained byte-for-byte; only separately licensed analytical lyric nodes are omitted before conversion.

All four horn source parts P10–P13 use old bass-clef notation in XML measure128, canonical q474–480. That convention sounds one octave above ordinary treble-clef transposition: apply+12 only in that span, preserving engraving, rather than publishing impossible C1/E1 horn pitches. Independent rule review: International Horn Society, https://www.hornsociety.org/publications/horn-call/horn-call-archive/149-advice-for-amateurs . Other source transpositions remain active.
Custom MIDI score bypasses musicxml2ly articulate playback so durations describe written notation.
